metrics.label: ARC-AGI
metrics.description: Abstract visual grid puzzles where the model must infer a transformation rule from a few input-output demonstrations and apply it to a novel case. Scored as accuracy (% of tasks solved); higher is better.

metrics.label: ARC-AGI-2
metrics.description: A substantially harder successor to ARC-AGI: abstract grid puzzles stressing compositional and symbolic reasoning, two attempts per task (pass@2). Scored as accuracy (% of tasks solved); higher is better.

metrics.label: APEX Agents
metrics.description: Professional deliverables across investment banking, consulting, law, and primary care that would take practitioners hours, graded against pass/fail rubric criteria. Scored as % of rubric criteria satisfied; higher is better.

metrics.label: GSO
metrics.description: Software performance engineering: the model rewrites real GitHub code to speed it up. Scored OPT@K (% of trials reaching at least 95% of the human speed-up); higher is better.

metrics.label: PostTrainBench
metrics.description: AI R&D automation: a CLI agent must post-train a small base LLM on a single GPU within a time budget to raise its downstream scores. Scored as the average improvement across base models and evaluations; higher is better.

metrics.label: WeirdML
metrics.description: Unconventional machine-learning engineering tasks where the agent must write and run code to train a model on provided data, with several iterations allowed. Scored as accuracy on the held-out task; higher is better.

metrics.label: Chess Puzzles
metrics.description: 100 programmatically generated chess positions (in FEN) where the model must name the single best move as judged by Stockfish. Scored as accuracy (% of positions with the correct move); higher is better.

metrics.label: GPQA Diamond
metrics.description: 198 'Google-proof' graduate-level biology, chemistry, and physics questions that stump non-experts even with web access. Scored as accuracy (% correct); higher is better.

metrics.label: OTIS Mock AIME
metrics.description: 45 competition-style math problems from the 2024-2025 OTIS Mock AIME exams (integer answers 0-999), harder than MATH Level 5 but easier than FrontierMath. Scored as accuracy (% correct); higher is better.

metrics.label: SimpleBench
metrics.description: Common-sense reasoning 'trick' questions about space, time, and social cues that are easy for people (84% human baseline) but hard for models. Scored as accuracy (% correct); higher is better.

metrics.label: SimpleQA Verified
metrics.description: A cleaned 1,000-prompt factuality benchmark of short fact-seeking questions, measuring parametric knowledge and resistance to hallucination. Scored as accuracy (% answered correctly); higher is better.
